description: Na₂CoH₁₂(SO₇)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.67 Å. Co is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.23 Å. There are six inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.99 Å) and one longer (1.70 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.00 Å) and one longer (1.61 Å) H-O bond length. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.00 Å) and one longer (1.65 Å) H-O bond length. In the sixth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.49 Å) and two longer (1.50 Å) S-O bond lengths. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Co and two H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one H, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Co and two H atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na, one Co, and two H atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one H, and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one H, and one S atom.
